title: Predictive AI vs. Generative AI: A Comparative Overview
description: Predictive AI analyzes past data to forecast future trends and events, helping make informed decisions. Generative AI creates entirely new content, like images or text, based on patterns learned from existing data. While both use machine learning, generative AI focuses on creating new information, while predictive AI concentrates on predicting the future.
